name: Reunion of Old Friends
description:
As long as the uncooperative bodyguards are taken care of, Swire doesn't lack methods to make one talk. 
<Deep Water Zone>Unable to deploy on these tiles. Enemies on these tiles have reduced ASPD and Movement Speed, and continually lose HP
Condition:Tidal Leaders and Tidal Leader Speedboats have reduced ATK, but deal greatly increased Corrosion

abilities.text: Attacks deal damage to the target and all allied units in the target's four adjacent tiles, additionally inflicting <$ba.dt.erosion>Corrosion Damage</>
The <Tidal Leader> will continue battle after the vehicle is destroyed
Death deals Physical damage and <$ba.dt.erosion>Corrosion damage</> to surrounding units
Has a chance to dodge Physical attacks when not blocked
Quickly loses HP while under the effects of 'Erosion'
Immune to Erosion. While in water, gains increased ATK and <$ba.invisible>Invisibility</>
